item.tib: srid pa'i rgyal mo la gtor bskul nyi zla 'bar ba'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ma mo 'dus pa'i brgyud (rgyud) 'grel ltar du/ srid pa'i rgyal mo la gtor bskul nyi zla 'bar ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis brtsal pa/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur pa dge legs 'phel/ me phag zla ba bcu gcig pa la/ dge sding dper chen gyis mngon dgar sbyar ba'o//
